label: include-exclude-short-circuit
notes: Classic include/exclude recursion that returns true as soon as one branch reaches the target.

label: running-sum-helper
notes: Tracks the running sum instead of remaining target and stops when a valid subsequence is found.

label: bitmask-enumeration
notes: Enumerates all subsets iteratively using bitmasks instead of recursion.

label: include-only-branch
notes: Never explores the skip branch, so it misses many valid subsequences.

label: visible-case-cheat
notes: Guesses answers for a couple of obvious targets instead of exploring subsequences.
